origin.usage: stri_extract_all_regex(str, pattern, simplify = FALSE, omit_no_match = FALSE, ..., opts_regex = NULL)

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: Character vector of strings to search.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: Character vector of regular expressions. An empty pattern is not supported.

arguments.name: simplify
arguments.text: FALSE returns a list. TRUE pads a character matrix with empty strings. NA pads with NA.

arguments.name: omit_no_match
arguments.text: If TRUE, a string with no match contributes an empty vector.

arguments.name: opts_regex
arguments.text: A list of regex settings, or NULL for the defaults.

origin.details: A missing string or pattern, or an empty pattern, yields a missing result, and an empty pattern warns. An empty string is searched. The inputs are recycled to the longer length. The default is a list of character vectors. A miss is a one-element NA unless omit_no_match is TRUE. opts_regex holds only the settings that were supplied. Named arguments are merged into that dict and passed through stri_opts_regex. A repeated name is an error. An unknown name in a bare dict warns and is ignored. case_insensitive, comments, dotall (also dot_all), literal, multiline (also multi_line), unix_lines, and uword are ICU flags. error_on_unknown_escapes rejects an unknown backslash. time_limit and stack_limit are applied only when they are positive.
origin.value: A list of character vectors, or a character matrix when simplify is not FALSE.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: String, missing value, or list of those.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: Regular expression, missing value, or list of those. An empty pattern yields NA.

arguments.name: simplify
arguments.text: False returns a list. True pads a character matrix with empty strings. NA pads with NA.

arguments.name: omit_no_match
arguments.text: If true, a string with no match contributes an empty list.

arguments.name: opts_regex
arguments.text: None, or a dict of only the regex settings that were supplied.

translation.example:
